finalText:
Build is clean now, exit code 0.

Root cause: the bundler bump changed the options shape it hands to modules. Two call sites did not update to match.

- `src/core/options.js`: `resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. Fixed it to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js`: `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`, because the old config loader returned `false` for an unset flag and the new one returns `undefined`. Added a case that treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest of the noisy output (`DEP0142`, `DEP0198`, etc., and the `dedupe` lines) is a deprecation warnings from the new bundler version, not related to the failure — those are pending, unrelated migrations, not build breakers.
